from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, signal, time, json, hashlib

r = Path.cwd()
t = r / '.local/tool-tasks/pile-context-opportunity-20261009'
dll = t / 'build-probe/CombatSolver.dll'
assert dll.is_file()
results = []
for scene, control in [
    ('silent-large-deck', r / '.local/tool-tasks/deferred-shuffle-evaluation-20261009/fork-screen/silent-large-deck/A1'),
    ('screen-huge-deck', r / '.local/tool-tasks/native-sort-storage-20261008/screen/screen-huge-deck/A1'),
]:
    out = t / scene
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    control_command = json.loads((control / 'command.json').read_text())
    cmd = list(control_command['command'])
    for arg, value in [('--out', str(out)), ('--label', 'pile-context-opportunity-' + scene)]:
        cmd[cmd.index(arg) + 1] = value
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY_', 'COMBATSOLVER_TASK_', 'COMPlus_', 'DOTNET_'))}
    extra = {'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL': str(dll), 'COMBATSOLVER_TASK_PILE_CONTEXT_OUT': str(out / 'pile-context.json')}
    env.update(extra)
    record = {'scene': scene, 'command': cmd, 'environmentOverrides': extra, 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120,
        'dllSha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'controlCommand': control_command,
        'scope': 'read-only unchanged-pile census; not a safe cache certificate or performance acceptance'}
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    started = time.monotonic()
    print('START ' + scene, flush=True)
    timed = False
    with (out / 'stdout.log').open('w') as stdout, (out / 'stderr.log').open('w') as stderr:
        p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = p.wait(timeout=120)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed = True
            os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                code = p.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                code = p.wait()
    record.update(exitCode=code, timedOut=timed, processWallSeconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    if (out / 'result.json').exists():
        x = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
        a = json.loads((control / 'result.json').read_text())
        comparisons = {k: x[k] == a[k] for k in ['rootContinuationStamp', 'budget', 'status', 'timeBoundaryObserved']}
        for name in ['quality.json', 'search-policy.json']:
            comparisons[name] = json.loads((out / name).read_text()) == json.loads((control / name).read_text())
        comparisons['logicalWork'] = all(x['solverMetrics'][k] == a['solverMetrics'][k] for k in ['totalExpanded', 'totalTransitions', 'totalChoiceBranches'])
        h = json.loads((out / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
        comparisons['rootLiveEqual'] = h['search']['rootLiveStamp'] == x['rootContinuationStamp']
        record['comparisonToExistingControl'] = comparisons
        record['wallSeconds'] = x['wallSeconds']
        record['quality'] = json.loads((out / 'quality.json').read_text())
    if (out / 'pile-context.json').exists():
        counts = json.loads((out / 'pile-context.json').read_text())
        keys = ['CardVisits', 'EligibleCardVisits', 'HitCardVisits', 'LargePileCardVisits', 'LargePileHitCardVisits']
        sums = {k: sum(v[k] for v in counts.values()) for k in keys}
        sums['hitCardVisitFraction'] = sums['HitCardVisits'] / max(1, sums['CardVisits'])
        record['opportunityTotals'] = sums
    results.append(record)
    (t / 'probe-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({k: record.get(k) for k in ['scene', 'exitCode', 'timedOut', 'comparisonToExistingControl', 'opportunityTotals']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if code:
        raise SystemExit(code)
